about: How a scene's first line says what happened (the fact `happened`), by which fact of the cause record (causeRecordFacts, src/director/cause-facts.ts) names it, the first that the record holds in this order (Words lead, Nov 15: 'about minimum wage' and 'about assault' do not read).
